# Uni-CLI

Uni-CLI gives AI agents one command model for searching and operating websites, browser sessions, desktop apps, files, local tools, external CLIs, MCP servers, accessibility, and visual control.

## Operation Snapshot

- Static adapter sites: 338
- Registered adapter commands: 1891
- Runtime scope: fixed core and host-discovered commands are additional
- Adapters: 1268 (1009 YAML + 259 TypeScript)
- Built-in actions: 113 (58 registered + 55 transport-native)
- Tests: 10392

## Agent Contract

- Start with `unicli search "your intent"`, then run `unicli <site> <command> [args]`.
- Prefer `-f json` for scripts and `-f md` for agent-readable prose.
- On failure, read the v2 error envelope, update the source named by `error.adapter_path`, then run `unicli repair <site> <command>`.
- Native CLI exposes the complete process surface. MCP provides compact, deferred, and expanded profiles from the same operation catalog.

## Markdown Companions

Every public page below has a clean Markdown companion. Fetch Markdown first; fetch rendered HTML only when visual layout matters.

## Use Uni-CLI

- [Find An Operation](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/) — Search Uni-CLI by intent, inspect the matching command, and run it with structured output. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide.md
- [Authentication](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/authentication) — Set up site credentials, import a browser session, and diagnose login state. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide/authentication.md
- [Browser And Desktop](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/browser-desktop) — Choose a browser session, inspect page state, and control desktop applications through Uni-CLI. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide/browser-desktop.md
- [Recipes](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/RECIPES) — Short, copyable Uni-CLI workflows for web data, research papers, authenticated sites, and browser sessions. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/RECIPES.md
- [Repair And Evolve](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/self-repair) — Read an adapter failure, update the named source, and verify the original operation. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide/self-repair.md
- [Trace Scholarly Work](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/scholarly-discovery) — Find papers, reviews, rebuttals, awards, PDFs, code, and datasets through one source-backed workflow. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide/scholarly-discovery.md
- [Archive OpenReview](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/openreview-archive) — Create a resumable local archive of a public OpenReview venue. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide/openreview-archive.md

## Build

- [Create An Adapter](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/guide/adapters) — Add a site or tool to Uni-CLI with a YAML adapter and test it locally. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/guide/adapters.md
- [Adapter Format](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/ADAPTER-FORMAT) — Complete field reference for Uni-CLI YAML adapters and the TypeScript registration path. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/ADAPTER-FORMAT.md
- [Pipeline Steps](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/reference/pipeline) — Built-in actions available to YAML adapters, with common shapes and the complete current action list. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/reference/pipeline.md
- [Plugin Authoring](https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/PLUGIN) — Package adapters, pipeline steps, and runtime extensions for Uni-CLI. Markdown: https://olo-dot-io.github.io/Uni-CLI/markdown/PLUGIN.md
